newsitem.title: UK: Boeing brings the floor down at air show.
newsitem.headline: Boeing brings the floor down at air show.

text.p: A news conference by U.S. aerospace heavyweight Boeing Co at the Farnborough air show ended in farce on Monday as the floor gave way under the weight of journalists crammed into the press room.

Show organisers quickly evacuated reporters packed into the briefing room, after the president of Boeing Commercial Airplane Ron Woodward closed the news conference, which had attracted huge numbers and turned the room into a sweltering hothouse.

The unexpected end to the to the briefing meant arch rival European Airbus Industrie, which had booked the same room for its news conference to follow immdiately after, had to postpone its briefing until Tuesday morning.
Boeing announced orders totalling $6.3 billion from seven customers for a variety of passenger planes.
